import hashlib
import json
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "carebridge-ai"

def read(name):
    raw = (root / "evaluation" / name).read_bytes()
    return json.loads(raw), hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

full, full_sha = read("spec-gpu-v9.json")
targeted, targeted_sha = read("spec-context-qa-v2.json")
baseline, baseline_sha = read("spec-gpu-v8.json")
review, review_sha = read("spec-reference-review-v9.json")
contract, contract_sha = read("backend-contract-spec-v9.json")
extra_contract, extra_contract_sha = read("backend-contract-spec-context-v3.json")
assert full.get("finished_at") and targeted.get("finished_at")
assert full["code_sha256"] == targeted["code_sha256"] == baseline["code_sha256"]
assert full["corpus_sha256"] == baseline["corpus_sha256"] == targeted["corpus_sha256"]
assert full["runner_sha256"] == baseline["runner_sha256"]
assert full["config"] == baseline["config"]
assert full["model_snapshot"] == baseline["model_snapshot"] == targeted["model_snapshot"]
assert full["runtime_versions"] == baseline["runtime_versions"]
assert full["adapter_sha256"] == baseline["adapter_sha256"]
assert contract["evaluation_sha256"] == review["evaluation_sha256"] == full_sha
assert extra_contract["evaluation_sha256"] == targeted_sha
for path, digest in full["code_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, path
observations_path = Path(__file__).with_name("gpu-resource-v9-observations.jsonl")
observations_raw = observations_path.read_bytes()
observations = [json.loads(line) for line in observations_raw.splitlines()]
assert observations
old_success = {r["id"]: r for r in baseline["translations"] if r["http_status"] == 200}
new_translations = {r["id"]: r for r in full["translations"]}
matched = [cid for cid in old_success if new_translations[cid]["http_status"] == 200]
old_failures = [r["id"] for r in baseline["translations"] if r["http_status"] != 200]
recovered = [cid for cid in old_failures if new_translations[cid]["http_status"] == 200]

def get_local(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as response:
        return json.load(response)

health = get_local("http://127.0.0.1:8002/health")
assert health["status"] == "ok" and health["translation_loaded"] and health["stt_enabled"]
result = {
    "schema": "carebridge.gpu-isolation-recheck.v1",
    "recorded_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "git_revision": full["git_revision"],
    "full_evaluation_sha256": full_sha,
    "targeted_evaluation_sha256": targeted_sha,
    "failed_baseline_evaluation_sha256": baseline_sha,
    "reference_review_sha256": review_sha,
    "backend_contract_sha256": contract_sha,
    "targeted_backend_contract_sha256": extra_contract_sha,
    "observations_sha256": hashlib.sha256(observations_raw).hexdigest(),
    "same_app_code_corpus_runner_config_weights_runtime_and_adapter_as_v8": True,
    "previous_generation_failures": len(old_failures),
    "previous_generation_failures_now_http_200": recovered,
    "matched_success_latency": {
        "case_count": len(matched),
        "v8_p50_seconds": median(old_success[cid]["seconds"] for cid in matched),
        "v9_p50_seconds": median(new_translations[cid]["seconds"] for cid in matched),
        "scope": "Same successful case IDs in both runs; one measurement per case per run, not a load benchmark.",
    },
    "current_app_code_hashes_verified": True,
    "resource_observations": observations,
    "all_samples_ollama_empty": all(not s["ollama_models"] for s in observations),
    "sampling_limit": "Point-in-time samples, not continuous proof of exclusive GPU use. Desktop apps may also use GPU resources.",
    "full_summary": full["summary"],
    "workflow_passed": full["workflow_passed"],
    "workflow_total": full["workflow_total"],
    "targeted_passed": targeted["passed"],
    "targeted_total": targeted["total"],
    "restored_service_health": health,
    "ollama_models_after_restore": get_local("http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps")["models"],
    "interpretation": "Compare this completed run with the preserved interrupted v8 run. Conditions without a loaded Ollama model were observed, without changing app code or inference limits. This supports investigating resource competition but is not a randomized causal experiment or native-language accuracy measurement.",
    "recorder_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
}
with (root / "evaluation/spec-context-resources-v9.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"samples": len(observations), "all_samples_ollama_empty": result["all_samples_ollama_empty"], "summary": full["summary"], "workflow": [full["workflow_passed"], full["workflow_total"]], "targeted": [targeted["passed"], targeted["total"]], "same_code_and_settings": True, "restored_service": health}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
